notes.title: UPDATE 1.1: ADDED LANGUAGES AND FEEDBACK
notes.notes:
[h1]New Update Announcement[/h1]
We’ve been working hard for the last couple of days to update Kika & Daigo: A Curious Tale.
We’re very excited to tell you about the newest feature. The newest feature includes different languages, so you can enjoy the game even more in the language of your choice!
 
The added languages are:
- Dutch
- Danish
- French
- German 
- Japanese
- Korean
- Portuguese
- Russian
- Spanish
- Turkish

Players were also confused about not being able to play when they started the game. We have now added a popup that clearly shows the player that the game is not detecting a controller and that you cannot play the game until you plug in a controller.

- Volume options added to the menu
- Some options are now available from the in game menu
- PS4 Controller support improved
- Added a pop-up that tells you when your controller is not connected
- Fixed a lot of bugs!

Update Kika & Daigo: A Curious Tale now to experience the fun!.
We hope you enjoy the game! Let us know what you think?
